Results.ReviewText: I’m a ride-or-die charcoal griller, but we took this with us to Grand Teton/Yellowstone so that we could have a grill that was easy to clean and then put out of reach of bears!  Weber came through beautifully.  I was very impressed with the control, and the ease of use.
Results.Title: Love this adorable li’l grill!

Results.ReviewText: I have only had my Weber BBQ for a short time but it has been a joy to use and savor the flavor of all my meals for family and friends.  I had been without a BBQ for almost a year and missed it very much.  My new Weber Q 1200 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane) unit is a wonder relief to use.
Results.Title: Summer is here!! Let's BBQ again.

Photos.Caption: cracked regulator gasket after less than 1 year of use

Results.ReviewText: The propane regulator gasket for my grill has cracked after less than 1 year of use and is leaking propane and posing a severe safety/fire hazard. When I contact the warranty department, they keep asking for documentation which I have already uploaded. This is a dangerous product and Weber is failing to address my concerns. They have outsourced their customer service and it takes 24 hours to get a response between messages. I would love to be able to use my grill but can't. A simple gasket which should cost 50 cents requires replacement of a $75 part.
Results.Title: Defective propane regulator gasket.

Results.ReviewText: Works great. Took it camping, used it several times. Heats up fast, even cooking and fast cleanup. Little on the heavy side though.
Results.Title: Great product

Results.ReviewText:
I did a lot of research on the weber brand barbecue. It was worth the extra money its an awesome barbecue. I went with the 1200 due to the thermometer which is very handy to have. I thought one burner wouldn't be enough but this small barbecue has a lot of cooking power. 
I clean it every time i use it and the grills are very easy to clean. 
I would recommend this barbecue to anyone who wants to downsize to a smaller barbecue.
The stand that i bought with it added a nice finishing touch and i also bough the cover.
Results.Title: Awesome little barbecue

Results.ReviewText: This is the second Q grill we have had over the past 10 yrs. We use it camping. Not only does it grill, we also use the optional griddle plates. And, with the dome lid, we have used it as an oven.
Results.Title: Awesome and versatile grill

Results.ReviewText: Perfect BBQ for downsizing to our Condo balcony. And we can fold it up to go on those Oilers tailgate parties!
Results.Title: Condo & To Go Perfect!

Results.ReviewText: Great Grill for the price.  The left side generates more heat than the right side.  So one has to plan accordingly, such as grilling veggies on the right side while the mains on the left side.
Results.Title: Great Little Grill for the $$$$$$.

Results.ReviewText: We didn't have our grill longer than for 2 weeks, when the control valve regulator went out.  This has to be ordered.  The one we had last had the same thing happen.  Never thought we'd have to replace the control valve so soon.  We don't know if we'll ever purchase another Weber, as they don't make them like they used to.Weber
Results.Title: Weber Grill

Results.ReviewText: For years we had a full sized gas grill. Now that we are downsized empty nesters use the Weber Q1200. We've grilled everything that we like to grill on the Q1200 and the results are excellent. It heats up quickly, provides consistent heat, and is easy to clean. Definitely one of our better purchases.
Results.Title: Replaced our large grill with a Weber Q1200

ClientResponses.Response: We appreciate your feedback. So sorry to hear about your situation. Hopefully no one was injured. We do see you have a case with our specialty team working on a resolution. If you need anything further please let us know. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Our grill almost burned our house down. We had it heating up for about 5 minutes and it seems the regulator blew out and the propane ignited with flames about 3 feet to the side. It scorched our house and melted the griddle and stand. Scary.
Results.Title: Weber 1200

Results.ReviewText: Love this little guy, perfect steaks every time and just the right size for two. I still have my large grill for when my family and friends come over but this jewel is our go to for every day use.

Results.Title: Excellent design

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We are so sorry to hear your grill is not getting as hot as you would have expected. We are here to help and will look into this further. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: Very disappointed. Weber has such a great rep, but the Q1200 has underperformed. Instructions say it should be heated to 500-550 degrees when started (and that's good for cleaning after grilling, too); but it struggles to get to 400. Maybe 425, if the wind is blowing right. I've used both the 1lb gas containers and the larger tank with a hose, and I still have the problem. (And yes, I follow instructions to insure the shutoff doesn't get triggered, which I gather is a common problem.)
Results.Title: If you need heat, get something else.

Results.ReviewText: This grill has great features. Love the colapsible feature.
Results.Title: The BEST COMPACTIBLE GRILL EVER

Results.ReviewText: Had a problem withe the regulator on one of my Weber grills,  the quick response and the free replacement part that was under warranty, that is why I only buy Weber grills
Results.Title: Great response

Results.ReviewText: I love my weber Q 1200. I have wanted one for a long time and it did not disappoint.  Cooks  even. Food tast great and easy to clean.
Results.Title: Awesome Grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use. Cooks evenly. Sides fold in. Heavy and sturdy.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: These little grills are the best! I highly recommend to anyone lookig for a portable unit.
Results.Title: Get one now.

Results.ReviewText: This grill heats up fast and cleans up easily.  It is a perfect size to haul around in my Airstream when I go camping.  Yes I have an oven but there is nothing better than cooking burgers, steaks, chicken, fish, and veggies on an outdoor grill.  This Weber is the best!  And so easy to clean because the grates are heavy duty and the disposable grease pan is a fantastic idea.
Results.Title: Wish I had purchased it sooner!

Results.ReviewText: I bought my Q1200 hearing my friends rave! Sadly, the regulator did some sorta malfunction so the burner wouldn’t light! Spring had Sprung so move over air fryer the BBQ is back, but I couldn’t get the BBQ to light. Called customer service number and in minutes I had a new regulator under warranty on the way!!! Easy instructions included in the box how to replace the part and just like that I have flame! For real now air fryer can move over as BBQ steaks rule supreme in our home! I was so excited to try it out I made old school burgers with the universal bread slice! Thank you so much Weber for standing behind your product!
Results.Title: Amazing customer service

ClientResponses.Response: Your feedback is very important to us. We are so sorry to hear you are having an issue with the valve and regulator. Our Care team is reaching out to follow up with you. Please look for an outreach email from us soon. Thank you!

Results.ReviewText: I was very excited to receive my lime green Q1200 Weber the folding side tables and the brand name with availability of parts was a key factor in purchasing the Weber product. It is my first portable but 2 Weber product . I didn’t buy my Weber new. I bought it on marketplace. The woman used it three times and was selling it for a fairly reasonable price for new 2 months used. The barbeque lights well the main issue is that there’s virtually no heat. I went to Weber‘s website. I’ve tried the problem solution and to no avail the regulator is at fault. I believe this is the reason the barbeque went upon to Marketplace and unfortunately, the price of a new regulator doesn’t warrant the price I bought the unit for so I will be putting it back on marketplace at a loss stating needs new regulator.
Results.Title: Excellent design

Results.ReviewText: We have owned several Weber grills…currently own 3.  When doing the pre use heating up the grill for 10 minutes there was a discovered hiccups !!!   The heat/flame adjustment knob did nothing to lower heat/ flames :(       Call support at Weber…said we needed a new regulator…. Came in about 10 days.  It did nothing to help issue.  Currently on vacation and using grill as long as you lift lid to check meat temperature can be controlled.   Pain in the butt.
Results.Title: Small but mighty

Results.ReviewText: This is exactly as you would want for a tailgater.  I also use it for my alternative backyard cooking method.  Great tech.  It is easy to enjoy.
Results.Title: Amazingly simple

Results.ReviewText: Awesome portable grill. Perfect choice for tailgating and a great travel companion. Love the easy clean out tray and cooks evenly. I would love to see a warming tray to fit inside since it had a tendency to burn the outside even at the lowest setting when cooking burgers . Looking forward to purchasing your new Searwood 600 pellet smoker as well.
Results.Title: Grilling on the go

Results.ReviewText: This is a convenient little grill for a small family. With only 2 in my household the size fits our needs perfectly. I did however have to buy an adapter for the propane as my small bottles would not screw on to the original fitting. I also would have preferred a porcelain coated grate for easier cleaning. Otherwise though it seems durable, works like a charm, and I like it’s portability.
Results.Title: Nice little grill

Results.ReviewText: I love the portable Weber 1200 grilll. The only improvements I would suggest are adding hooks to hang the bbq accessories. Now that would be great!
Results.Title: Love my Weber 1200

Results.ReviewText: Everything we ordered came faster than we were told. First time to order parts for our Q1200 gas grill. Had it for years an we are so happy with it. Best grill ever. Great job weber. Thanks for a awesome grill an customer service.
Results.Title: Great customer service

Results.ReviewText: This grill is perfect for me. I live alone in a condo with a small back yard. It is the perfect size and easy to use. Not only does it accommodate what I cook for myself but is also large enough for when guests and family come over for meals. It’s easy to light and easy to clean. The accessories available will allow me to expand my use. I’m looking forward to using my grill more and more.
Results.Title: Perfect for me
